# Test fixtures

This folder holds IFC files used by the tests and the examples, and the script
that makes one deliberately broken file.

## Attribution: buildingSMART sample files

The four files named `bsi_*.ifc` are copied, unchanged, from the
buildingSMART sample repository:

- Source: <https://github.com/buildingSMART/Sample-Test-Files> (GitHub also
  serves it at `buildingSMART/sample-test-files`; the names are not case sensitive)
- Copyright: © buildingSMART International Ltd.
- Licence: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  (CC BY 4.0), as stated in the repository's `LICENSE` file.
- Copied from commit `80d976a9b193a26a8e928c3e79bff67af1de68a8` (committed 2026-09-04).

Required attribution for reuse: credit buildingSMART International as the author
of the sample files, link to the source repository, and say whether changes were
made. No changes were made to the content. The files were renamed when copied
to this folder, and the new names are shown in the table.

Each file is byte-identical to its upstream original. The SHA-256 of each file
matches the one in the table. Check with `sha256sum`.

| File here | Original path in the repository | Schema (FILE_SCHEMA) | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bsi_ifc2x3_building_architecture.ifc` | `IFC 2.3.0.1 (IFC 2x3 TC1)/Simple-Scene/Building-Architecture.ifc` | IFC2X3 | `c4db65ba847f6b369a95d6c54fa11f4750cbe6d59f021934e8923d8d578e5885` |
| `bsi_ifc4_building_structural.ifc` | `IFC 4.0.2.1 (IFC 4 ADD2 TC1)/Simple-Scene/Building-Structural.ifc` | IFC4 | `903b5a005901397aa2b235daf6a60f46c099eae286cb01c815abf0a341707432` |
| `bsi_ifc4_building_hvac.ifc` | `IFC 4.0.2.1 (IFC 4 ADD2 TC1)/Simple-Scene/Building-Hvac.ifc` | IFC4 | `2c17ecad2b0fbd3335420ee42ba48963b5a395294e86bcdcfc786ee559f9a344` |
| `bsi_ifc4x3_infra_bridge.ifc` | `IFC 4.3.2.0 (IFC 4.3 ADD2)/Simple-Scene/Infra-Bridge.ifc` | IFC4X3_ADD2 | `97e84cb93e07bfbedbc1bdc57aef161f4998e09accd77175dd0561af2ab4ffab` |

All four files come from the repository's "Simple-Scene" folder. They are the
same sample scene, exported in different schemas and for different disciplines.
The project header is the same in each. Counts below are the number of instances
of each entity in the file (type definitions are not counted).

### `bsi_ifc2x3_building_architecture.ifc`

- Schema IFC2X3, view definition CoordinationView V2.0, exported from SketchUp.
- Length unit: millimetre (`IFCSIUNIT` with `MILLI`).
- One building (`IFCBUILDING`), one site, one storey named `00 groundfloor`.
- Walls 4 (`IFCWALL`), slabs 3, roof 1, spaces 2, zone 1, furnishing element 1,
  building element proxies 5.
- Uses property sets (`IFCPROPERTYSET`, 2) and quantity sets with
  `IFCQUANTITYVOLUME`, `IFCQUANTITYAREA` and `IFCQUANTITYLENGTH`.
- No beams, no doors, no windows.

### `bsi_ifc4_building_structural.ifc`

- Schema IFC4, reference view V1.2, exported from SketchUp.
- Length unit: millimetre. Projected CRS `IFCPROJECTEDCRS` with a map conversion.
- One building, one storey, 2 sites.
- Beams 6, walls 4, roof 1, footing 1, chimney 1, discrete accessories 2,
  building element proxies 2.
- Has quantity sets (volume, area, length) and classification references.
- No element in this file carries `Pset_WallCommon`; walls fail the wall property rules.

### `bsi_ifc4_building_hvac.ifc`

- Schema IFC4, reference view V1.2, exported from SketchUp.
- Length unit: millimetre. Projected CRS `EPSG:32760` (WGS 84 / UTM zone 60S).
- One building, one storey, 2 sites.
- Air terminals 2, duct segment 1, distribution system 1, chimney 1, building
  element proxies 2.
- **No walls and no beams.** Useful for "applies to nothing" cases.

### `bsi_ifc4x3_infra_bridge.ifc`

- Schema `IFC4X3_ADD2` (read as `IFC4X3`), reference view, exported from SketchUp.
  Projected CRS `EPSG:32760`. A bridge model: bridges, bridge parts, beams, columns,
  footings and earthworks.
- **No storeys.** Spatial structure is site (6), bridge (3) and bridge part (18).
- Beams 8, columns 7, footings 7, members 8, walls 4, slabs 3, railings 2,
  earthworks fills 4, element assemblies 2, signs 4, building element proxy 1.
- Has quantity sets (volume, area, length).

## `broken_building.ifc`: a deliberately invalid fixture

`broken_building.ifc` is **not** a buildingSMART file. It was generated by the
VeriModel project with `tests/fixtures/make_broken.py`, and it is covered by the
repository's licence. It is an IFC4 model in millimetres with one storey. It
contains eight known defects, so that tests can check that each one is caught:

| # | Defect | Expected rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Two walls share the same GlobalId | ID-001 |
| 2 | A slab has a 7-character GlobalId (`BADID01`) | ID-002 |
| 3 | A column is not contained in any storey | SP-001 |
| 4 | A wall is extruded with zero thickness (zero volume) | GEO-002 and QT-001 |
| 5 | A beam is placed 25 km from the origin | SP-004 |
| 6 | No wall carries `Pset_WallCommon.FireRating` | IDS and CFG-PSET rules |
| 7 | `Pset_WallCommon.Reference` is an empty string | PR-001 |
| 8 | Two walls are both named `Wall` | ID-003 |

It also contains a healthy door with `Pset_DoorCommon`, so that at least one
element passes every check. The units are millimetres on purpose, so the unit
conversion is exercised: the healthy wall is 5000 mm long, 3000 mm high and
200 mm thick, which is 3.0 m³.

To make it again, run `python3 tests/fixtures/make_broken.py` from the
repository root. The script writes `broken_building.ifc` into this folder.
